details.description: MythoMax-L2-13B is a 13-billion-parameter merge model built by the independent creator Gryphe by combining two Llama-2-13B-based models, MythoLogic-L2 and Huginn, using individualized merge ratios applied across 363 tensors. It is tuned for roleplaying and creative storywriting rather than general instruction-following. Gryphe's own model card describes it as a legacy release that is 'fading away' following the release of Llama 3, positioning it as an older option among newer alternatives.
advantages: Combines MythoLogic-L2, described by Gryphe as its 'more robust understanding' component, with Huginn, described as its 'creative writing' component, via a custom per-tensor merge.
Available in GGUF, GPTQ and AWQ quantized formats, per its Hugging Face card, suited to local or self-hosted inference.
disadvantages: Gryphe's own model card states it is being 'phased out' following the release of Llama 3, calling it a legacy model relative to newer options.
Listed under a non-standard 'other' license on its Hugging Face card rather than a standard open license.
No benchmark scores are published on its model card.
use_cases: Local or self-hosted deployment via quantized GGUF/GPTQ/AWQ builds

notes: No context window is stated on Gryphe's card; catalog's 4,096-token input/output limit could not be independently confirmed against a source but was not contradicted. No maker site beyond the Hugging Face card was found.
